processDescription: CNC turning of titanium on multi-axis lathes produces cylindrical components with precision diameters and surface finishes. Live tooling enables milling and drilling in the same setup, specifically for bracket. Precision bracket for Aerospace present unique challenges: Complex organic geometry with multiple thin-wall lugs. 5-axis simultaneous machining required to eliminate second op setup errors.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-tool for chip breaking and heat evacuation.
flatnessControl: Steady rests for long slender parts. Stress-relieved stock recommended.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for CNC milling/turning of brackets and alignment blocks, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
